notes.title: MindKatt - Update:
notes.content:
Update Notes:

Code optimization and bug fixes.
Improved combat system.
Adjustments and fixes to various animations.
General balance applied to enemies.
Important Notice:
The game will conclude its early access phase with the release of the prologue chapter in the coming months.

I hope you enjoy this update! Your feedback and suggestions are always welcome.
